name: KENT Sand Filter
summary: KENT Automatic Sand Filter removes visible dirt, sand, silt, and suspended particles from water using an advanced 3-step filtration process.
intro: KENT Automatic Sand Filter effectively removes visible dirt, sand, silt, and suspended impurities (turbidity) from water, ensuring cleaner water for household use. With a high flow rate of up to 3000 L/hr, advanced 3-step filtration, and a non-electric, low-maintenance design, it is ideal for tap, river, and borewell water applications.
features: Advanced 3-Step Filtration for effective impurity removal
High Flow Rate: Up to 3000 L/hr
Removes sand, silt, dirt, and suspended particles (turbidity)
Suitable for tap, river, and borewell water
Non-electric operation for low running costs

rows: Removes visible dirt, suspended matter, and sand particles from water
